verdict: key consistent: 32 signs = 32 letters, 8 groups = 8 words, one letter per shape, one shape per letter; but the second word is not جنانك: the signs give ي?تال (يختال read from context, S6 a singleton), and فقلت is قلت
notes: Rows: 11r segmenter lines 5-6 (record's 5-6). Measured 15+17 = 32 signs (record 33) and 7 dividers (record 7; 11r.5 ends with one). Record errors: (1) the second word has 5 signs S5 S6 S7 S1 S4 whose last four are the ت ا ل of قلت / كاتب / لما (S7 = ت in قلت and كاتب, S1 = ا 8 times, S4 = ل 7 times) and whose first is S5 = ي (as in يا): the word is ي?تال, not جنانك; the classic phrase أقبل يختال ('he came strutting') gives S6 = خ (S6 occurs once, so خ is not checked; يحتال or يغتال would fit the count as well); (2) the third word is 3 signs S2 S4 S7 = قلت (S2 = ق as in اقبل twice), not فقلت; the cipher has no ف anywhere. The text as enciphered: أقبل يختال، قلت لما أقبل: يا كاتب السلامه. The two اقبل groups are identical (S1 S2 S3 S4). The record's 'fits: 33 = 33' was right by chance (its جنانك فقلت has the same letter count as يختال قلت).
